title: CITERIFT Stage 04 DETECT candidate-result batch, version 1
description: Owner decision D-055: a content-addressed, immutable blob of the candidate results of one DETECT attempt, committed by one candidate_result_batch_recorded journal record. Each entry binds the records of one work candidate: its claim, the decision on that claim and the question the claim opens (null when it opens none). Batching is storage only: an entry never merges two candidates, and the claim, decision and question keep exactly the payloads the claim_recorded, decision_recorded and question_opened records held before. Entries are in the order of SPEC 8.9 (cand_ref, then claim_id) and cut by the byte ceiling of SPEC 8.8 (d). Investigation Memory checks the entries on append and on open and W-8 checks them at step_succeeded; a missing or corrupt batch is corruption, never an empty batch.

order.description: The ordering rule the entries follow (SPEC 8.9).
